details: The front paid 4 attempts to find an accepted sha; every landing in relay is a fast-forward, so the hint never fits.

details: CONFIRMED by a scratch test. In _commit_on_default the range branch computes base with `git log -1 --format=%H sha -- <item>`
and, when base is empty, uses `rev-list --first-parent sha` (all history). An empty base means the item's file is absent
from sha's history (sha predates the item) or the read failed; in neither case does "the range it closes carry code".
The code even documents "a failed read counts as inert" for _carries_code, yet here a failed read widens to accept.
Reachable by a wrong or stale sha typed into --evidence (the front tried 4 shas in the incident that raised the item).
evidence: (sha O stored as evidence for item "late", added after O)
rc, out, _ = _git(main, "rev-list", "--first-parent", f"{base}..{sha}" if base else sha)
failing_case: Repo: seed item feat, "the change" (lib/foo.py), then an inert commit O (.relay/checks/old.gate.log), then a new item
late.json added. `relay queue done late --evidence <O>`: now ACCEPTED, evidence stored = O, a commit made before the item
existed. `git log -1 O -- .relay/queue/late.json` is empty, so rev-list runs over all of O's history, which holds
"the change". The old code refused O ("changes only inert files"). Should: refuse, as before.
The same path opens when `git log` fails (its exit code is ignored): base "" again, whole history, accepted.
fix_hint: Take the range branch only when `git log` exits 0 and base is non-empty; otherwise fall through to the refusal. Add pass
case 1 as a test (fails on the current branch, passes after).
pass_cases: 1. Inert commit O made before the item's file exists, a code commit before O: done --evidence O is refused, the message
names a code commit, master unchanged.
2. Item touched (take), then code commit C, then inert gate-log head H: done --evidence master accepted, evidence = H
3. Item touched, then only an inert head H: refused naming the last code commit, which is then accepted
4. A code commit as evidence is accepted whatever its age (test_a_short_sha_of_the_default_branch_is_stored_as_the_full_sha).
reason: test_an_inert_commit_older_than_the_item_is_refused passes; fails at 7bea9f4. Empty base or failed git log now falls to refusal.
findings.summary: an inert commit older than the item (or any failed `git log`) is accepted: an empty base makes the range the whole history
